judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasing late-day sky with warmly lit cumulus and deep blue tones, though the dark foreground and ordinary composition keep it from standing out more.
strengths: Warm low-sun light on the cumulus
Layered cloud interest from wisps to puffs
weaknesses: Foreground is very dark and underexposed
Horizon line is cluttered and heavy
